hooks.name: Sync GGYGO README after source create
hooks.description: 当 Source/GGYGO 下创建新文件后，提醒登记文件和架构变化。

action.prompt: A new file under Source/GGYGO/ was just created. Follow the workspace skill sync-ggygo-readme: inspect the file and update Source/GGYGO/README.md in the same task with its ownership, role, path, and validation status. Do not modify README.md merely because this reminder fired if no documented architecture fact changed.
